# Third-party code structure

| Directory | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `autotom/model/` | Model backend and interface utilities |
| `notices/upstream/` | Upstream license texts |
| `notices/EnactTom/` | EnactToM license and package metadata |

Benchmark-specific dependencies are stored with their pipelines: EnactToM under `benchmarks/habitat/external/`, and the SAM launcher under `benchmarks/comind/cap-x/`.
